thread:
Asha (sales): SlateBridge POC inbound. They want a drop-in for CompetitorX's /v1/generate. Main asks: prompt parity, token billing delta, SSO (SAML), BYOK for prod. Can we list POC gates?
Vik (solutions): Quick gates: 1) API envelope mapping shim, 2) canonical prompt parity suite, 3) token accounting + billing estimate, 4) security Q answers, 5) rollback path.
Marta (presales): I'll pick 10 prompts (summary, rewrite, extraction, edge unicode). We'll run side-by-side and produce BLEU/ROUGE + token delta per prompt.
Ethan (ML Eng): Heads-up: CompetitorX tokenizes some smart-quotes and emojis differently -> expect ~5% token delta for some inputs. I'll add a "compat" variant toggling repetition_penalty and tokenizer pre-normalization.
Priya (Security): For POC they accept platform-managed KMS; production wants BYOK. Need SAML metadata, IP allowlist, retention <=30d, and DPA before sharing raw prompts.
Asha (sales): SlateBridge also asked about latency SLAs for staging. Can we commit to <=1.5x competitor in us-west?
Ethan (ML Eng): We can target that in staging with our quantized runtime; include float16 run in matrix.
infra-bot: staging cluster ready: slatebridge-poc (egress IPs: 52.23.111.44, 52.23.111.45)
Vik (solutions): Adapter example (pseudo):
// competitor -> {"id":"r","text":"...","usage":{"tokens":120}}
// shim -> {"request_id":"r","choices":[{"text":"..."}],"usage":{"total_tokens":120}}
Marta (presales): I'll produce a Postman collection + runner script that outputs TSV: prompt,redwood_out,competitor_out,redwood_tokens,competitor_tokens,latency_ms.
Asha (sales): Pricing ask: can we offer a 30-day trial credit and a 3-month ramped commit discount for Dedicated?
Vik (solutions): Yes. Drafting a proposal: trial credits -> month2 25% commit discount -> month3 50% -> month4+ full commit.
Priya (Security): Action: I'll draft security Q responses and check on-prem evaluation option. Legal review required for DPA.
Asha (sales): Kicking off live sync Thu 9am PT. Action owners: @Marta test harness, @Vik pricing, @Ethan variants+seed, @Priya security Q. Keep updates here.
